items.title: Don Menza and Sam Noto interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 28, 1997
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well the band, when I joined it was an all-star band. It was Lee Konitz, Zoot Sims and all those people were on that band.

ctx.x: It was popular then but I mean his music was popular. It was a big time band in the late ‘40s, early ‘50s, it was huge.

Well the band, when I joined it was an all-star band. It was Lee Konitz, Zoot Sims and all those people were on that band. And that was — Conte, and then that was close to a swinging band also, because those were all pretty heavy jazz players. Frank Rosolino was on the band.
While we’re talking about great arrangers, you guys have written a great deal of music yourself, and was it a self-taught thing, or did you — from listening again and trying things out?
